BUILD THE APK
Option A (no Android Studio): push this folder to a new GitHub repo.
  Actions tab > "Build APK" > run > download artifact "PdfFiller-debug-apk".
Option B: open this folder in Android Studio > Build > Build APK(s).
  Output: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
Install: copy the APK to your phone and allow "install unknown apps".
